script_text: Sagittarius, this week, your fire sign gets a reality check, then a financial plot twist. Tuesday through Wednesday, the Sun in your 7th House squares Saturn in your 4th House, so a partner may feel heavy; Tuesday is hardest because that square tightens. As a fire sign ruled by Jupiter, you want movement, not red tape. Wednesday turns sharper when Mercury conjuncts Mars in your 6th House, making contracts demand quick edits. Thursday brings Venus in your 10th House trining Mars, so a polished pitch can turn practical. By the weekend, the Sun enters your 8th House and conjuncts Jupiter, your ruler, opening shared money, tax, debt, or intimacy talks. Sunday is your power day because Sun-Jupiter in the 8th sextiles Uranus in your 7th House. Tuesday is your worst day because Sun-Saturn exposes a relationship deadline. Put numbers in writing. Follow for daily updates.
